text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: Lutro is a game development framework based on the LÖVE engine and designed for creating small 2D games using Lua scripting. It provides tools for graphics, input, audio, and game logic while keeping a simple structure inspired by classic game development environments. Lutro projects can be used with compatible emulation environments and are focused on accessible homebrew-style development.
